description: Renovables CyL: zonas exclusión eólica is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idecyl.jcyl.es. Indicative mapping of the land on which renewable energy installations and their ancillary infrastructure projects would not be authorised in accordance with Article 13 of "Decree-Law 2/2022 of 23 June 2022 adopting urgent measures to speed up the management of European funds and boost economic activity" (BOCYL 24.06.2022). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "CyL Renewables: Wind Exclusion Zones" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2023-02-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
